vertical: # Fill one row per vertical as you work. After 5-10 STRANGER clients (not friends
# of Daniel's) the winning column is usually obvious. Niche then - not now.
# The columns that actually decide it:
#   conversations / prospects_contacted  -> how easy is it to get the owner on the phone
#   closed / conversations               -> does the pitch land in this vertical
#   avg_setup_price                      -> can they carry real money
#   hours_to_fulfill                     -> is delivery repeatable or bespoke
#   kept_monthly_60d                     -> THE most important column. Recurring is the business.
#   second_problem_observed              -> missed calls / unclosed estimates / dormant customers
#   do_i_like_these_owners               -> not soft. You will do this for years.
# The rule: niche around the REPEATED EXPENSIVE PROBLEM you discover
# industry that sounded good in advance.
